mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime (INDPRO < 95.0), industrial production contraction reduces corporate profitability and increases input costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A positive trend in real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of market conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annual CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals rising price pressures that may prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative stance suppresses bond yields and encourages risk-taking, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.
